contentPattern.structure: repeating rows of year + description; rendered as a vertical timeline with a green spine and markers, cards alternating left/right on desktop

suitableFor: roadmap or 'how it works' step sequences with a short label + text

authoring.model: One row per entry. Cell 1 = year (prominent marker label). Cell 2 = description paragraph. The section heading (e.g. 'Our history') is authored as default content above the block.
authoring.note: Brand-new block, not derived from a vanilla Block Collection block. DA project — no _timeline.json modeling file.
